item.title: One winter storm boosts Utah snowpack, but drought concerns remain
item.description: The recent storm is a positive step, but it’s only one piece of a much larger picture. Officials emphasize that long-term conservation habits remain essential as the state heads toward summer.

item.title: Consensual sex between residents, employees in long-term care raises concerns
item.description: An 18-year-old high school student who worked at a nursing home started having sex with multiple residents, then told his friends they should also apply for jobs in these facilities.

item.title: Federal loan limit cuts threaten self-help housing program in Cache County
item.description: A program that helps families in Cache County buy their own home with the help of their own "sweat equity" is making some big changes, which leaves many in limbo.
